Airam services ceiling cassettes in offices, clinics, restaurants and retail across Chennai, in slots before you open or after you close. From ₹1,299 per unit, with digital GST invoices and up to a 90-day warranty on repairs.

symptoms.title: Water dripping from the grille
symptoms.description: Condensate escaping through the vents usually means a clogged drain tray or a drain pump on its way out.

symptoms.title: Gurgling above the ceiling
symptoms.description: A drain pump straining against a blocked line makes itself heard before it makes itself seen.

symptoms.title: One vent blowing weak
symptoms.description: When a single flap of a four-way cassette loses airflow, dust-choked filters or a stuck louvre motor is the usual cause.

symptoms.title: Musty blast at startup
symptoms.description: Chennai's humidity breeds mould in the drain tray, and the first burst of air each morning carries it into the room.

symptoms.title: Stained tiles around the unit
symptoms.description: Brown rings spreading on the false ceiling mean condensate has been leaking above it for weeks.

symptoms.title: Cooling fades by mid-afternoon
symptoms.description: A dirty coil keeps up in the morning but surrenders once the 40°C peak load arrives.

faqs.question: Can you service our cassettes outside business hours?
faqs.answer: Yes — that is how most of our commercial clients book us. We take early-morning, late-evening and weekly-off slots so your showroom or clinic never closes for maintenance. Same-day slots are available when a unit fails suddenly.

faqs.question: Why is my cassette AC dripping water?
faqs.answer: Cassettes rely on a small drain pump to lift condensate into the ceiling drain line — gravity does not help them the way it helps wall splits. In Chennai's humidity that pump moves litres a day, and a blocked tray or failed float switch sends water straight through the grille. We test the pump and flush the line on every service.

faqs.question: Will you damage our false ceiling?
faqs.answer: No. Our technicians are trained on tile-grid and plaster ceilings, lay dust sheets before the panel comes off, and refit the grille flush when done. The unit goes back looking the way your interior designer intended.

faqs.question: How often should office cassettes be serviced?
faqs.answer: Every three to four months for most Chennai sites — dust, footfall and coastal air load the filters fast, and 40°C summers punish a dirty coil. Restaurants and clinics often need shorter cycles because of grease and hygiene demands. For multiple units, an AMC keeps the schedule automatic and the paperwork consolidated.

faqs.question: Which cassette brands do you service?
faqs.answer: All major brands — Daikin, Blue Star, Voltas, Carrier, Mitsubishi Electric, O General, Hitachi, LG, Samsung and Panasonic. Cassette internals vary by brand, particularly drain-pump and float-switch design, and our technicians carry the fitment knowledge for each.
